title: Duprey 2010 costovertebral joint range of motion between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm

quantity.name: range of motion
quantity.definition: angle change between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm (torsion: twice the 0 to 0.1 Nm range)

source.authors: Duprey S, Subit D, Guillemot H, Kent RW
source.sample: 15 costovertebral joint samples (ribs 2-10) from 3 male PMHS

protocol.summary: Costovertebral joint (costocentral + costotransverse) with vertebra potted; rod along the rib cervical axis; forces applied on the rod to create rotation about X (rib neck axis, torsion via rack and pinion), Y (normal to transverse-process facet; cranial-caudal flexion) and Z (ventral-dorsal flexion); quasi-static ~3 mm/s; moment = force x lever arm; characteristic average and corridors by Lessley et al. method; ROM = angle change between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm (torsion: 2 x 0-0.1 Nm).
how_to_simulate: Fix the vertebra; apply moments to the rib about the rib-neck axis (X), Y and Z axes as defined (origin at costocentral joint centre)
Compare moment-angle response with the characteristic average and corridor polynomials; report ROM between -0.1 and +0.1 Nm

extraction.check_notes: All-sample averages from Results text. Comparable in definition to Lemosse 1998 MLS (+-0.1 Nm) - see lemosse1998 neutral_zone tests (different group because axes/definitions differ slightly).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
